examples.label: Fingerprint Tomcat via the docs page

notes: /docs and /manager confirm Tomcat and its version; the manager app is the real target. If /manager 403s from your IP it may still be reachable via the AJP/Ghostcat path.

recommended.note: Attack the manager login once found.
If AJP/8009 is exposed, read config files without creds.

name: Tomcat - Detect and Enumerate
description: Fingerprints Tomcat via the /docs page and brute-forces paths. Key targets: /manager, /host-manager (deploy WARs), and tomcat-users.xml for credentials.

defense.why_it_works: Tomcat exposes version information in error pages, /docs/ page, and well-known paths /manager, /host-manager. Gobuster or direct curl retrieves the version string reliably without authentication.
defense.prerequisites: Network access to port 8080/8443. No credentials required for fingerprinting.
defense.impact: Version confirmation enables CVE targeting. Manager URL confirmed for credential attack.
defense.detection: GET requests to /docs/, /manager/html, /examples/ from unauthenticated IP. Gobuster patterns in access logs.
defense.artifacts: Access logs (GET /docs/, /manager, /examples/) | IDS alerts for web server enumeration pattern
defense.prevention: Remove /docs, /examples, /host-manager webapps from production. Set server.xml Server attribute to empty string. Restrict /manager to localhost only.
defense.misconfiguration: Default Tomcat installation includes /docs, /examples, and /manager accessible from any IP with verbose error pages revealing the exact version.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# server.xml default
<Connector port="8080" Server="Apache-Coyote/1.1"/>
# webapps contains: docs/, examples/, manager/, host-manager/
defense.secure_config:
# Suppress version
<Connector port="8080" Server=" "/>
# Remove unused webapps
rm -rf $CATALINA_HOME/webapps/docs $CATALINA_HOME/webapps/examples
# Restrict manager to localhost
<Valve className="org.apache.catalina.valves.RemoteAddrValve"
       allow="127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+"/>
